coordinates: Blender meters X east/Y north/Z up. Every semantic module is authored inside its owning approved Bastion blockout envelope from the reset scene; export origin corresponds to the upper-terrace Bastion cluster.

production_intent.hero_hierarchy: Primary: central keep + long curtain silhouette. Secondary: east tower, left wing, far-west block, gate head. Tertiary: belts, buttresses, crenellation groups, recesses and heraldry.
production_intent.asymmetry: East tower taller/heavier than west; rear far-west block creates counter-rhythm; keep crown and gate crest intentionally nonuniform; no mirrored tower clones.
production_intent.identity: Valoria warm military masonry with blue/gold heraldry, battered/chamfered masses, deep reveals and broad crown sections; avoids generic round-tower castle-kit silhouette.
production_intent.mobile_rule: Large forms and coarse crenellation carry identity. No quality argument may depend on microdamage or dense ornament.
production_intent.envelope_rule: No authored vertex may exceed its owning Bastion blockout envelope; asset serves locked frame.
